node.statement: Constant absorption and application of lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control: take its universal witnesses C0,kappa0. Choose a universal C_ch >= max(C0,K,4) large enough that every fixed product used in the tangent distortion is bounded by 1+C_ch*epsilon_r for 0 <= epsilon_r <= 1/4, and set kappa_ch=min(kappa0,1/4). If C_ch*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa_ch with delta>0, then C0*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa0 and epsilon_r<1/4, so the external graph theorem applies; enlarging C_ch once more does not spoil this implication.
